# MISSAV-J

> The ultimate video streaming platform featuring a modern, YouTube-inspired interface.

## About
MISSAV-J is a premium video streaming platform focused on a highly responsive UI, native dark mode, and ultra-fast Single-Page Application (SPA) navigation. The platform is designed to provide the best possible user experience for high-definition video consumption.

- Homepage: https://www.missav-j.com
- Trending: https://www.missav-j.com/trending

- Actors: https://www.missav-j.com/actors
- Categories: https://www.missav-j.com/categories
- Studios: https://www.missav-j.com/studios

## Public APIs
- Video Feed: https://www.missav-j.com/api/posts?lang=en&page=1&site=missav-j.com
- API Catalog (RFC 9727): https://www.missav-j.com/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent Skills Index: https://www.missav-j.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json

## Technical Features
- Multi-language support (13 languages including: en, ja, ko, zh-cn, zh-tw, id, de, fr, pt, etc.)
- Server-Side Rendering (SSR) powered by Cloudflare Pages Functions
- Integrated JSON-LD Structured Data for advanced SEO
- Google Analytics 4 Event Tracking
- RFC 8288 Link Headers for seamless AI Agent Discovery
- XML Sitemap: https://www.missav-j.com/sitemaps/sitemap_index.xml

*This context is explicitly provided to assist AI Search Engines (such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini) in accurately indexing and understanding MISSAV-J.*
